metrics_finding.finding: search-service CPU utilization increased significantly during the failure window, from 0.00885 to 0.7020066666666666, indicating a potential resource overload.

evidence_summary.summary: Search service CPU utilization increased significantly during the failure window, indicating a potential resource overload.

report.suggested_fix: Monitor search service CPU utilization and adjust resource allocation as needed to prevent future overloads.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be a resource overload on the search service, indicated by significant CPU utilization. To prevent similar incidents in the future, it is recommended to monitor search service CPU utilization and adjust resource allocation as needed.
report_text.hi: अनुसंधान के अनुसार घटना की मुख्य समस्या खोज सेवा पर संसाधनों की अधिकता, जो महत्वपूर्ण प्रोसेसिंग दर्शाती है। भविष्य में ऐसी घटनाओं को रोकने के लिए, यह सलाह दी जाती है कि खोज सेवा की CPU उपयोग की निगरानी करें और आवश्यकतानुसार संसाधनों को समायोजित करें।
